details: Bitcoin's price climbed past $85,000, trading between $84,890 and $85,469, marking a 0.4% increase over 24 hours. This surge followed the release of August's US Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, which rose at a 3.4% annual rate, down from 3.7% the previous month, signaling cooling inflation.
title: Bitcoin Rises Past $85K on Cooler US Inflation Data

details: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) registered Coinbase Clearing LLC as a derivatives clearing organization, enabling Coinbase to manage derivatives clearing internally. This move gives Coinbase in-house control over a function it previously outsourced and is noted as the first USDC-native derivatives clearing entity.
title: Coinbase Gains In-House Derivatives Clearing Approval from CFTC

details: Cronos (CRO) experienced a nearly 7% decline in the last 24 hours, primarily due to increased US regulatory scrutiny on its affiliated exchange, Crypto.com. The US House Oversight Committee expanded an insider-trading probe into prediction markets to include Crypto.com, focusing on identity verification and suspicious trading activity.
title: Cronos (CRO) Drops Amid US Regulatory Scrutiny of Crypto.com

details: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce, widely known as "Crypto Mom" for her advocacy for clearer digital asset regulations, submitted her resignation, effective October 2, 2026. Her departure, after nearly nine years, leaves uncertainty in crypto oversight, especially as the CLARITY Act remains stalled.
title: SEC Commissioner Hester Peirce to Resign, Impacting Crypto Oversight

details: Spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) continued their positive streak with significant inflows, while US spot Ethereum (ETH) ETFs recorded $2.81 million in net outflows on September 29, ending a seven-day inflow streak.
title: Bitcoin ETFs See Inflows, While Ethereum Funds Experience Outflows
